vocab.sentence: When Cole feels angry, he often breathes deeply to calm himself down.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 當 Cole 生氣時，他常會深呼吸，讓自己冷靜下來。

vocab.sentence: Rita was so hungry that she took a huge bite of the wheel cake and swallowed it whole.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Rita 餓極了，咬了一大口車輪餅，整口吞了下去。

vocab.sentence: Thanks to the nurse, the injury to Mike's finger soon became less painful.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 多虧護理師幫忙，Mike 手指上的傷很快就沒那麼痛了。

vocab.sentence: It is annoying that people talk during movies.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 有人在電影播放時說話，令人很煩。

vocab.sentence: The typhoon was a great disaster in this area. Many people lost their homes because of it.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這場颱風是這個地區的一場大災難，許多人因此失去家園。

vocab.sentence: We learned how to survive in the mountains.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我們學了如何在山中生存。

vocab.sentence: Cockroaches are one of the creatures that I dislike the most because they make me feel sick.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 蟑螂是我最討厭的生物之一，因為牠們讓我覺得噁心。

vocab.sentence: To protect the environment, we can choose to use reusable chopsticks instead of single-use ones.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 為了保護環境，我們可以選擇使用可重複使用的筷子，而不用免洗筷。

vocab.sentence: Don't throw your trash into the river! You will pollute the water.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 別把垃圾丟進河裡！你會污染河水。

vocab.sentence: My sister loves to float her toy rubber ducks on the water when she takes a bath.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我妹妹洗澡時，喜歡讓她的玩具橡皮鴨浮在水面上。

vocab.sentence: Despite the bad weather, the boat arrived at the shore without incident.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 雖然天氣不好，船仍平安抵達岸邊。

vocab.sentence: Ryan is in urgent need of medicine, or he may become too weak to stand.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Ryan 急需藥物，否則他可能會虛弱得無法站立。

vocab.sentence: This laptop is on sale. The price has been reduced from twenty thousand to ten thousand dollars.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這台筆電正在特價，價格已從兩萬元降到一萬元。

vocab.sentence: The baby is making an effort to climb the stairs by himself.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這個寶寶正努力自己爬上樓梯。

vocab.sentence: Mandy and Brian's relationship is in crisis. They fight more and more often.
vocab.sentence_chinese: Mandy 和 Brian 的感情出現危機，他們吵架的次數越來越多。

vocab.sentence: I learned how to cook. Meanwhile, my brother washed the dishes.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我學習如何煮飯，同時我哥哥在洗碗。

vocab.sentence: Smoking is banned in this restaurant, so customers need to go outside to smoke.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 這間餐廳禁止吸菸，因此顧客必須到外面抽菸。

vocab.sentence: Tickets to that show are currently available, so let's get some soon.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 那場表演目前還有票，我們趕快買幾張吧。

vocab.sentence: I was wondering who put this love letter in my desk drawer.
vocab.sentence_chinese: 我在想，是誰把這封情書放進我的書桌抽屜裡。

phrases.sentence: When Mary realized that she stepped on Jack's foot by accident, she immediately apologized to him.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Mary 發現自己不小心踩到 Jack 的腳時，立刻向他道歉。

phrases.sentence: Leo drank too much, so he is now throwing up in the restroom.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Leo 喝太多了，所以現在正在廁所嘔吐。

phrases.sentence: The doctor said that there was too much gas in my stomach because the food wasn't broken down well enough.
phrases.sentence_chinese: 醫生說我的胃裡有太多氣體，因為食物沒有被充分分解。

phrases.sentence: Kate decided to cut down on sugary drinks to stay healthy.
phrases.sentence_chinese: Kate 決定少喝含糖飲料，以保持健康。

tips.label: 疑問詞 + to V
tips.text: what to do（該做什麼）、where to go（該去哪裡）、when to leave（該何時離開）、who to ask（該問誰）、how to do it（如何做這件事）。to 後面用原形動詞。

tips.label: 是否要做
tips.text: whether to V 表示是否要做某事：We haven't decided whether to go. 不能把 whether 換成 if。

tips.label: 有些、其他一些、還有一些
tips.text: Some ... Others ... Still others ... 表示不同群體；Others 與 Still others 後面不再接名詞。

tips.label: 後面有名詞
tips.text: 接複數名詞時，用 some students、other students、still other students；不能寫 others students。

notes.title: 疑問詞搭配不定詞
notes.rule: 疑問詞 + to + 原形動詞
notes.description: 用疑問詞 + to V 表示該做什麼、該去哪裡、該何時做或如何做。to 後面用原形動詞；本課直接練習這種片語，不練習完整子句的改寫。
examples: I don't know how to fix it.（我不知道如何修好它。）
The teacher told us what to bring.（老師告訴我們該帶什麼。）
Please tell me when to start.（請告訴我該何時開始。）

notes.title: 依句意選擇疑問詞
notes.rule: what / where / when / who / how + to V；which + 名詞 + to V
notes.description: what 表示事物，where 表地點，when 表時間，who 表對象，how 表方法。which 可以接名詞，表示在選項中選哪一個。what to do 中的 what 是 do 的受詞；how to do it 中的 how 表方法，do 仍需要受詞 it。本課不使用 why to V。
examples: Please tell me what to do.（請告訴我該做什麼。）
Please show me how to do it.（請示範如何做這件事。）
We can't decide which road to take.（我們無法決定該走哪條路。）
I don't know who to call or when to leave.（我不知道該打電話給誰，或該何時離開。）

notes.title: whether 後面可以接不定詞
notes.rule: whether + to V；whether to V ... or ...
notes.description: whether to V 表示是否要做某事，也可以接 or 說明另一個選項。此句型使用 whether，不能改成 if to V。
examples: We haven't decided whether to join the cleanup.（我們還沒決定是否參加清理活動。）
They are discussing whether to stay or leave.（他們正在討論要留下還是離開。）

notes.title: 原形動詞與並列動作
notes.rule: wh- + to + 原形動詞；how to V and V
notes.description: to 後面使用原形動詞，不使用 V-ing 或第三人稱單數形式。兩個並列動作可共用前面的 to，也可以各自保留 to。若是兩個不同的名詞片語，則可分別使用疑問詞。
examples: She taught me how to breathe slowly.（她教我如何慢慢呼吸。）
We learned how to find water and build a fire.（我們學了如何找水與生火；build 和 find 共用 to。）
He explained where to put the paper and how to sort the bottles.（他說明紙該放哪裡，以及如何分類瓶子。）

notes.title: 將許多人或事物分成幾群
notes.description: Some 表示有些，Others 表示其他一些，Still others 表示還有另外一些。這種說法不一定列完全部成員，也不表示總共只有三個人或三件物品。指可數複數群體時，動詞需配合複數主詞。
examples: Some students are reading. Others are writing. Still others are drawing.（有些學生在閱讀，有些在寫字，還有一些在畫畫。）
Some drinks contain sugar. Others do not.（有些飲料含糖，其他一些則不含糖。）
Some creatures live in water, but others live on land.（有些生物住在水裡，其他一些則住在陸地上。）

notes.title: other 後有名詞，others 單獨使用
notes.rule: other + 複數名詞 = others；still other + 複數名詞 = still others
notes.description: Other students 與 Others 都可表示其他一些學生，但不能把兩種形式混成 Others students。Some 可接複數名詞，也可以單獨使用。判斷空格時先看後面是否還有名詞。
examples: Some students walk to school. Other students ride bikes.（有些學生走路上學，其他一些學生騎腳踏車。）
Some students walk to school. Others ride bikes.（others 代替 other students。）
Some shops sell food. Other shops sell clothes. Still other shops sell books.（有些商店賣食物，有些賣衣服，還有一些賣書。）

quiz.question: The gym teacher taught us how ___ through our noses during the exercise.
quiz.hint: how to breathe 表示「怎麼呼吸」。how 後接 to + 原形動詞 breathe。

quiz.question: I don't know what ___ if the lights go out again.
quiz.hint: what 是 do 的受詞，what to do 表示「該做什麼」。

quiz.question: The two buses leave from different stops. Which stop ___ is still unclear to us.
quiz.hint: which stop 整組放在前面，後接 to use。Which stop to use 是 is 的主詞。

quiz.question: We've packed everything. We just need to decide when ___ for the beach.
quiz.hint: when to leave 表示「何時出發」，to 後接原形 leave。

quiz.question: The pool is closed today. We haven't decided where ___ instead.
quiz.hint: where 問地點，where to swim 表示「該去哪裡游泳」。

quiz.question: I found a lost dog, but I don't know who ___ for help.
quiz.hint: who 指「該打給誰」，是 call 的受詞，後接 to call。

quiz.question: Dad showed me how ___ my name on the form.
quiz.hint: how to write 表示「該怎麼寫」。showed me 表示要學著寫的人是我。

quiz.question: The lake is very deep. We have to decide ___ to swim here or go to the pool.
quiz.hint: 兩種選擇用 whether to swim here or go to the pool，表示要在這裡游泳還是去游泳池。whether 可直接接 to V，if 不可以。

quiz.question: I already have a jacket, but I'm wondering ___ to bring an extra one.
quiz.hint: 空格表示「是否」要多帶一件外套，用 whether to bring。bring 已有 an extra one 作受詞。

quiz.question: We don't know whether ___ the road now or wait for the light.
quiz.hint: whether 後用 to + 原形動詞 cross。後面的 wait 和 cross 是兩個選項。

quiz.question: Please tell me ___ to do with these old bottles.
quiz.hint: what to do with these old bottles 是問「這些舊瓶子該怎麼處理」。do 缺少受詞，what 補上這個位置。how 表示方法，無法當 do 的受詞。

quiz.question: The little boy needs help. Can you show him ___ to open this jar?
quiz.hint: open 已有受詞 this jar。how to open this jar 問的是打開罐子的方法。

quiz.question: We have to paint one of these two walls. Have you decided which wall ___ first?
quiz.hint: which wall 是 paint 的受詞，整組放在 to paint 前面。

quiz.question: Grandma showed me how to peel an apple and ___ it into thin pieces.
quiz.hint: peel 和 cut 由 and 並列，共用前面的 to，所以 cut 用原形。

quiz.question: The teacher showed us how to float and how ___ back to the side of the pool.
quiz.hint: 這裡並列 how to float 和 how to swim，第二個 how 後也用 to + 原形動詞。

quiz.question: The sign tells us where to leave our bags and when ___ them up.
quiz.hint: where to leave 和 when to pick up 是兩個並列的疑問詞片語。when 後接 to pick。

quiz.question: I was nervous before the race. My friend told me who ___ if I needed help.
quiz.hint: who to ask 表示「可以找誰」。told me 提示去問的人是我，who 是 ask 的受詞。

quiz.question: The coach told us when ___ for the game. The team has to be there before noon.
quiz.hint: when to arrive 表示「該何時到達」。疑問詞 when 後接 to + 原形動詞 arrive。

quiz.question: The map shows where ___ after the show.
quiz.hint: where to meet 表示「該在哪裡集合」。where 後接 to + 原形動詞 meet。

quiz.question: I know how ___ the bike.
quiz.hint: how to fix the bike 表示「如何修理這輛腳踏車」。how 後接 to + 原形動詞 fix。

quiz.question: We haven't decided what ___ to the picnic.
quiz.hint: what to bring 表示「該帶什麼」。what 是 bring 的受詞，後面使用 to + 原形動詞 bring。

quiz.question: I showed Sam where ___ his bike.
quiz.hint: where to park his bike 表示「該把腳踏車停在哪裡」。where 後接 to + 原形動詞 park。

quiz.question: To cut down on waste, we need to learn how ___ more things at home.
quiz.hint: how to reuse 表示「怎麼再利用」，how 後使用 to + 原形動詞。

quiz.question: There are two bowls of soup. We still don't know which one ___ first.
quiz.hint: which one 指兩碗湯中的哪一碗，後接不定詞 to try。

quiz.question: There may be another storm tonight. We haven't decided whether ___ the trip.
quiz.hint: whether to cancel the trip 表示「是否要取消行程」，to 後用原形 cancel。

quiz.question: Some workers are cleaning the hall. ___ are moving the tables.
quiz.hint: 空格後沒有名詞，are 表示複數，所以用 Others 代替其他一些工作人員。

quiz.question: Some classes are reading outside. ___ classes are watching a video.
quiz.hint: 空格後有複數名詞 classes，使用 Other classes，表示其他一些班級。Others 是代名詞，後面不能再接 classes。

quiz.question: At the beach, some people swim. Others play ball. Still ___ sit under the trees.
quiz.hint: 第三群用 Still others。others 可以直接當 sit 的主詞。

quiz.question: Some groups clean the park. Others clean the street. Still ___ clean the beach.
quiz.hint: Some、Others、Still others 依序介紹不同群體。空格後直接接 clean，用 others 指第三群；單數 another 則須搭配 cleans。

quiz.question: Many small creatures live near the river. ___ hide under rocks when it gets hot.
quiz.hint: Some 可以單獨指部分小生物，搭配複數用的 hide。Another 和 The other 指單數，這裡的 Other 後面要有名詞。

quiz.question: Some of the buses stop by the school. ___ go straight to the train station.
quiz.hint: 空格單獨指其他一些公車，後面用 go，適合用複數代名詞 Others。

quiz.question: Some parents are bringing food to the party. ___ are bringing drinks.
quiz.hint: 空格後直接接 are bringing，用複數代名詞 Others 表示其他一些家長，與前面的 Some parents 呼應。

quiz.question: Some students reuse their old notebooks. Others share theirs with friends. Still ___ students bring scrap paper from home.
quiz.hint: 空格後有複數名詞 students，使用 Still other students，表示還有另外一些學生；不能寫 still others students。

quiz.question: Some rooms are open to visitors. ___ are used for classes.
quiz.hint: 空格後直接接 are，需要複數代名詞 Others。若後面有 rooms，則用 Other rooms。

quiz.question: There are many jobs at the school fair. ___ volunteers sell food, and others welcome visitors.
quiz.hint: Some 能直接修飾複數名詞 volunteers，引出第一群。

quiz.question: Some families take the bus to cut down on driving. ___ families ride their bikes.
quiz.hint: 空格後有複數名詞 families，使用 Other families。Others 單獨代替其他一些家庭，後面不再接名詞。

quiz.question: After the flood, some people are giving food. Others are bringing clean water. Still ___ are helping clean the streets.
quiz.hint: 前面已介紹兩群人，第三群用 Still others。空格後直接接 are helping，使用複數代名詞 others；another 是單數，不能搭配 are。

quiz.question: Some of the lights are on. ___ are off.
quiz.hint: Others 表示其他一些燈，能單獨作複數主詞，搭配 are。

quiz.question: Some children draw sea creatures. ___ make posters about the beach.
quiz.hint: Others 代替其他一些孩子，可直接作 make 的主詞，與前面的 Some children 呼應。

quiz.question: Many guests came early. ___ waited outside, others sat in the hall, and still others went to the garden.
quiz.hint: Some 單獨代替第一群客人。Other 這裡需要名詞，one of 和 the other one of 後面都需要補出所指的範圍。

quiz.question: At the pool, some children practice breathing. Others practice kicking. Still ___ children learn to float.
quiz.hint: 空格後有複數名詞 children，使用 Still other children。若省略 children，才使用 still others。

quiz.question: Some shops close early during the storm. ___ stay open until nine.
quiz.hint: 空格後是動詞 stay，選可單獨作複數主詞的 Others。

quiz.question: Some people think the new rule is annoying. ___ people think it's helpful.
quiz.hint: 空格後有複數名詞 people，使用 Other people，表示其他一些人；不能寫 Others people。

quiz.question: Some of the students collect bottles, and ___ pick up paper.
quiz.hint: 空格指另一群學生，後面沒接名詞，使用複數代名詞 others。

quiz.question: Some animals stay near the water. Others go into the woods. Still ___ hide under rocks.
quiz.hint: Some、Others 和 Still others 依序介紹不同群。這裡用 others 單獨指第三群。

quiz.question: Some paths lead to the river, while ___ lead into the forest.
quiz.hint: Some paths ... others ... 表示不同的路徑。空格後直接接 lead，用複數代名詞 others；單數 another 或 the other 須搭配 leads。

quiz.question: Some boxes are for paper. Others are for glass. Still ___ are for cans.
quiz.hint: Some、Others、Still others 依序介紹不同用途的箱子。空格後直接接 are，用複數代名詞 others。

quiz.question: Some bikes are ready to ride, but ___ need repairs.
quiz.hint: 空格指其他一些腳踏車，後面直接接 need，使用複數代名詞 others；單數 another 或 the other 須搭配 needs。

quiz.question: Some students have signed up for swimming lessons. ___ have joined the running club.
quiz.hint: Some students ... Others ... 表示參加不同活動的學生。空格後直接接 have，用複數代名詞 Others；單數 Another 或 The other 須搭配 has。

quiz.question: Some bags are made of cloth, while ___ are made of paper.
quiz.hint: Some bags ... others ... 表示不同材質的袋子。空格後直接接 are，用複數代名詞 others。

phrases.sentence_chinese: Kate 決定少喝含糖飲料，以保持健康。

grammar.sentence: Please show me how to breathe more slowly.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請教我如何放慢呼吸。

grammar.sentence: Some creatures sleep at night, but others stay awake.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些生物在晚上睡覺，其他一些則保持清醒。

grammar.sentence: We must learn what to do during a disaster.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們必須學會災難發生時該做什麼。

grammar.sentence: Some students walk to school, and others ride bikes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些學生走路上學，其他一些則騎腳踏車。

grammar.sentence: The nurse explained how to swallow the small pill.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 護理師解釋了如何吞下那顆小藥丸。

grammar.sentence: Some bags are red, and other bags are blue.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些袋子是紅色的，其他一些袋子是藍色的。

grammar.sentence: Do you know who to call about the incident?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你知道該打電話給誰詢問那起事件嗎？

grammar.sentence: Some students read, others write, and still others draw.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些學生閱讀，有些寫字，還有一些畫畫。

grammar.sentence: They are discussing whether to close the park today.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們正在討論今天是否要關閉公園。

grammar.sentence: Some shops sell food, and others sell clothes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些商店賣食物，其他一些則賣衣服。

grammar.sentence: She taught me how to float in the water.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她教我如何在水中漂浮。

grammar.sentence: Some children swim, and other children play volleyball.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些孩子游泳，其他一些孩子打排球。

grammar.sentence: We haven't decided when to start the cleanup.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們還沒決定何時開始清理。

grammar.sentence: Some visitors walk, others run, and still others cycle.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些遊客走路，有些跑步，還有一些騎腳踏車。

grammar.sentence: I wonder which book to read this weekend.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我在想這個週末該讀哪一本書。

grammar.sentence: Some drinks are sweet, but others have no sugar.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些飲料很甜，其他一些則沒有糖。

grammar.sentence: Dad showed us how to reduce food waste.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 爸爸教我們如何減少食物浪費。

grammar.sentence: Some people reuse bags, and others reuse bottles.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些人重複使用袋子，其他一些則重複使用瓶子。

grammar.sentence: He learned how to cut down on sugar.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他學會了如何減少糖分攝取。

grammar.sentence: Some students know what to do in a crisis.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些學生知道在危機中該做什麼。

grammar.sentence: Please tell me where to put these empty boxes.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請告訴我該把這些空箱子放在哪裡。

grammar.sentence: Some toys float, but other toys sink in water.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些玩具會漂浮，其他一些玩具則會沉入水中。

grammar.sentence: The guide explained how to survive in the forest.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 嚮導解釋了如何在森林中生存。

grammar.sentence: Some people cook, others clean, and still others rest.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些人煮飯，有些人打掃，還有一些人休息。

grammar.sentence: I don't know what to do about this noise.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我不知道該如何處理這個噪音問題。

grammar.sentence: Some bottles are empty, and others are full.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些瓶子是空的，其他一些則是滿的。

grammar.sentence: They are wondering how to protect the environment.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 他們正在想如何保護環境。

grammar.sentence: Some phones are new, and others are old.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些手機是新的，其他一些則是舊的。

grammar.sentence: We need to decide which road to take.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們需要決定該走哪條路。

grammar.sentence: Some tasks are urgent, but other tasks can wait.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 有些工作很緊急，其他一些工作則可以等。
